description: This file defines the TransactionsScreen widget for a Flutter application, which displays a list of recent financial transactions using provider state management. It includes asynchronous data fetching for category metadata and UI components for different transaction states.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of recent transactions with lazy category info loading.

classes.name: _TransactionsScreenState
classes.description: State class implementing the logic for TransactionsScreen, including data loading and UI build method.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Overrides the StatefulWidget lifecycle method to trigger loading of recent transactions once dependencies change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including CustomScrollView with Slivers to display transactions or loading and empty states.

methods.name: getCatMeta
methods.description: Asynchronous helper function for fetching category metadata by ID with caching.
